title: Hamilton Trading and Contracting Empowers Staff with ACMV Training in Qatar
excerpt: Hamilton Trading and Contracting WLL successfully conducted an ACMV (Air Conditioning & Mechanical Ventilation) training session for its technical team in Doha, Qatar. The training focused on improving HVAC system installation, maintenance techniques, and compliance with safety standards.
content:
Hamilton Trading and Contracting WLL successfully conducted an ACMV (Air Conditioning & Mechanical Ventilation) training session for its technical team in Doha, Qatar. The training focused on improving HVAC system installation, maintenance techniques, and compliance with safety standards.

This initiative enhances the company's ability to deliver top-tier MEP and HVAC services across commercial and industrial projects in Qatar.
author: Hamilton Team

title: Fire & Safety Awareness Training at Choice Food Factory
excerpt: Al Rawabi Group, in collaboration with Hamilton Trading & Contracting, conducted a Fire & Safety Awareness Training Program on August 2, 2025.
content:
Al Rawabi Group, in collaboration with Hamilton Trading & Contracting, conducted a Fire & Safety Awareness Training Program on August 2, 2025.

The session was led by Mr. Pranoy, a QCDD & ACMV Qualified Mechanical Engineer from Hamilton, who trained employees on fire prevention, safe evacuation, and proper use of firefighting equipment.
author: Hamilton Team

title: Hamilton Completes Fire System Works at Al Rawabi HQ
excerpt: Hamilton Trading & Contracting WLL is proud to have successfully completed the fire alarm and firefighting system works for the newly inaugurated Corporate Headquarters of Al Rawabi Group of Companies WLL, officially opened on 15th September 2025.
content:
Hamilton Trading & Contracting WLL is proud to have successfully completed the fire alarm and firefighting system works for the newly inaugurated Corporate Headquarters of Al Rawabi Group of Companies WLL, officially opened on 15th September 2025.

Our team ensured the highest standards of safety and compliance with international fire protection codes, delivering a state-of-the-art fire system to safeguard people and property.

We extend our congratulations to Al Rawabi Group on this remarkable milestone and thank them for trusting Hamilton as their partner in safety.
author: Hamilton Team
